terminal_reason: FIX-CA-13 fixed in PR #13246: AlertManager.send_alert returns bool with the redacted error; _drain_critical_alerts re-queues on failure (bounded 5, then ERROR UNDELIVERED); detector tests in tests/test_alert_drainer_main.py (fail on main 7d002927).
what: HIGH (code audit AUD-20260927-CA-A08-critical-alert-dropped-on-send-failure): A critical alert (e.g. 'Account auto-paused after N consecutive exchange rejections') is popped from the in-process queue before sending, and AlertManager.send_alert swallows every send exception, so a failed Telegram send permanently drops the alert and the caller's except-branch that would log it is dead code. PROPOSED FIX: Have AlertManager.send_alert return bool (or raise) and have _drain_critical_alerts re-queue alerts whose send failed (bounded retries), logging the exception message, not only its type name.
